verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs explicitly state that transformations (including dbt-based ones) are 'automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule,' and the platform supports Fivetran-hosted dbt Core plus dbt Cloud/Coalesce orchestration to run models after fresh loads rather than purely on a timer. This directly matches the story of dbt runs triggered by fresh data arrival. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that dbt-trigger-on-sync behavior works reliably in practice, and more detail on how trigger vs schedule is configured
